allowed_work: Run the repository image-health report once for the ten frozen IDs. Record checked_at, exact URL, HTTP status, content type, and classification. Add a health_check only for resources confirmed healthy and only when every current remote resource for that image is healthy; preserve non-healthy, blocked, and unreachable results as unknown without inferring an outage.
stop_conditions: Do not change image subject accuracy, media files, image ownership, credits, alt text, or rights metadata.
Do not retry a URL in this batch.
Do not inspect or mutate image IDs outside this frozen list.
done_criteria: All ten IDs receive one report result for each current remote resource.
Only a fully healthy resource set can receive a date-stamped health_check.
Fresh data:gaps inventory establishes the number of catalog image-health gaps actually closed.
Run npm run check once after image metadata changes; no image:report rerun.
